entities.name: Chelonians
entities.description: A race of turtlefolk on Madara who fiercely protect their homeland of Kusho.

entities.name: Kusho
entities.description: Homeland of the Chelonians, part of the Edemi Islands on Madara.

entities.name: Madara-Edemi War
entities.description: War in which the Chelonians sustained heavy casualties.

entities.name: Kappa
entities.description: Mysterious river-dwelling turtlefolk of Kamigawa, once thought extinct.

events.summary: The Chelonians suffered heavy casualties in the Madara-Edemi War but a population remained on Kusho.
events.quote: They sustained heavy casualties in the Madara-Edemi War
